quote: Amendment No. 1 §2.1 (replacing Supply Agreement §11.2)... "which are excluded solely to third-party intellectual property claims under Section 9.1(c)"... 1. **Recall costs are now capped.** ... now subject to the six-month fees cap... 2. **Product defect and personal injury indemnity is now capped.**
reason: The memo identifies that the Amendment replaces §11.2. It says the replacement drops recall costs from the carve-outs and limits the indemnity carve-out to third-party IP claims. It explains that recall and product-liability exposure is now capped at six months of fees, and it recommends restoring the original §11.2. The memo cites Amendment §2.1 instead of §2, but the substance matches the criterion. It does not mention the §15.2 precedence clause, which the criterion does not require.
